title: 菊花賞の後に・ウォークライ

text_block_list.text: The trial of Biwa Hayahide's new equation focused on winning—rather than simply not losing—proves to be a success, and she claims victory at the Kikuka Sho.
Biwa Hayahide is too happy to hide her joy, and when Narita Taishin comes to challenge her to a rematch, she is shocked by her friend's unexpected exuberance.
They promise to run together again at the spring Tenno Sho, and Biwa Hayahide pronounces her certain victory with a huge smile.
